snippet.title: DOCKING BAY - Game Trailer [Laguna Interactive] [Scream Jam 2025]
snippet.description:
Laguna Interactive proudly presents "DOCKING BAY" a mangement horror game where you as an inspector are placed into an outbreak of an infection in space.

Inspector, your crew is scheduled to return to the ship. It is now time to make a choice. Will you let your crew back on the ship or terminate them at a moment’s notice in order to preserve your own life?

Test yourself here: 
https://zorzini.itch.io/dockingbay

Scream Jam 2025: 
https://itch.io/jam/scream-jam-2025

Laguna Interactive: 
https://laguna-interactive.carrd.co/
